content.value:
Design an interface cireuit using the 8255A where the chip is selected when A:s is high. In (11)   
this desigo:   
i) Identify the port addresses.   
ii) Identify the Mode 0 control word to configure port A and port Cu as input ports, and port   
B and port CL as output ports.   
iii) Write a program to read the DIP switches and display the reading from port A at port B   
and from port Cu at port CL.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
